name: MonarchNotificationCenter
title: NotificationCenter
wrapsNative: List(.plain) of MonarchInboxRow buttons in day Sections, with MonarchTabs for All and Unread, .swipeActions(edge: .leading) to mark read, .toolbar with .cancellationAction and .primaryAction items, presented by the app in a .sheet inside a NavigationStack
summary: The in-app list of notifications: All and Unread tabs with the unread count, day groups, mark one or all as read, load more, and loading, error and empty states.
whenToUse: Behind MonarchNotificationsBell, presented in a .sheet inside a NavigationStack, or pushed as a screen, to list what happened in the app.
whenNotToUse: Not for system push notifications, which the system shows. Not for a conversation inbox; use MonarchInboxRow in a List. Not for a feed of changes to one record; use MonarchActivityTimeline.

options.name: items
options.description: The loaded notifications, newest first.

options.name: unreadCount
options.description: The unread total from the server, which may exceed the loaded items. The unread loaded items by default.

options.name: filter
options.description: The tab shown first. The component keeps the selection.

options.name: now
options.description: Fixes now for the compact times and the day headings. Without it times follow the clock.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: The first load: three redacted placeholder rows.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: The first load failed: MonarchErrorState with this title replaces the list.

options.name: hasMore
options.description: Another page exists: MonarchLoadMore at the end of the list.

options.name: isLoadingMore
options.description: A page is loading.

options.name: isLoadMoreFailed
options.description: The last page failed; the load-more row offers a retry.

options.name: groupsByDay
options.description: Groups items under Today, Yesterday and dates.

options.name: marksReadOnSelect
options.description: Calls onMarkRead when an unread item is activated.

options.name: showsDoneButton
options.description: Shows Done in the toolbar, which dismisses the presentation. Turn off when pushed.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the load-more row's.

options.name: onFilterChange
options.description: Receives the tab, for apps that fetch each tab from the server.

options.name: onMarkRead
options.description: Marks one item read. Adds the leading swipe action on unread items.

options.name: onMarkAllRead
options.description: Adds Mark all as read to the toolbar, disabled when nothing is unread.

options.name: onLoadMore
options.description: Loads the next page; also retries a failed page.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries a failed first load.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: An item was activated. Navigate to what it is about.

options.name: footer
options.description: Content after the list, such as a link to notification settings.

states.name: unread item
states.description: An accent dot before a bold title, and a semibold age, from MonarchInboxRow.

states.name: unread tab
states.description: Only unread items; the tab shows the unread count, 99+ above 99.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three redacted placeholder rows, read as Loading notifications.

states.name: error
states.description: MonarchErrorState with the message and a retry button.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState with a bell: You're all caught up, or No unread notifications in the Unread tab.

states.name: loading more
states.description: MonarchLoadMore at the end in its loading or failed state.

states.name: nothing unread
states.description: Mark all as read is disabled.

appearance: The surface background with plain list rows; day headings in the muted text colour; the unread dot from the accent's solid colour; the Unread tab's count uses the info tone. The mark-read swipe action is tinted with the info solid colour. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web component is a bell that opens a popover. On iOS the bell is MonarchNotificationsBell and the list is this view, presented in a .sheet with its own navigation bar, because popovers become sheets on iPhone anyway. Marking one item read is a leading swipe action, also a VoiceOver action, instead of a per-row button. Rows reuse MonarchInboxRow, so titles and messages are cut to one line each, and times are compact (5m, 3h) rather than 18 minutes ago. Items have no href: onSelect navigates. A custom empty state and a custom trigger are not offered. The Unread count uses the info tone because MonarchTone has no accent tone yet. Without now, day headings are computed when the view renders and do not change at midnight while it stays open.
accessibility: The tabs are MonarchTabs: a tab bar named Show, with the unread count in the Unread tab's name.
Each item is one button read as the title, Unread when unread, the full date and time, and the message, from MonarchInboxRow.
The unread dot is hidden; the state is spoken and shown by a bold title, not colour alone.
The mark-read swipe action is also a VoiceOver action named Mark as read.
Day headings have the header trait.
The loading placeholder is one element named Loading notifications; its redacted rows are not read.
Rows are at least 44 points high and grow with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: unreadCount larger than the loaded items keeps the tab count and enables Mark all as read.
Loading wins over an error; an error wins over the empty state; load more is hidden in all three.
An empty errorMessage is treated as no error.
Items keep the order given inside each day; days appear in the order of their first item.

examples.title: Bell and panel
examples.setup:
@State private var read: Set<String> = []

private let source = [
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id: "n1",
        title: "Ana Lopez mentioned you in Launch checklist",
        message: "“Can you confirm the legal sign-off date?”",
        time: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_772_451_720),
        actorName: "Ana Lopez"
    ),
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id: "n2",
        title: "Ben Okafor assigned you Update pricing page",
        time: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_772_442_900),
        actorName: "Ben Okafor"
    ),
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id: "n3",
        title: "Chloé Martin replied to your comment",
        message: "“Agreed, let’s ship the shorter version.”",
        time: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_772_438_580),
        isRead: true,
        actorName: "Chloé Martin"
    ),
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id: "n4",
        title: "Your weekly export is ready",
        time: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_772_386_200),
        isRead: true
    ),
]

private var items: [MonarchNotificationCenterItem] {
    source.map {
        MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
            id: $0.id,
            title: $0.title,
            message: $0.message,
            time: $0.time,
            isRead: $0.isRead || read.contains($0.id),
            actorName: $0.actorName
        )
    }
}

parityExceptions.reason: The list is presented as a sheet with a Done button in its title bar; the web's bell trigger and popover are not drawn.
parityExceptions.convention: HIG: a sheet is dismissed by its own Done button
